svg.title: One staff request traced through every layer
svg.desc: A new local-test request travels from the browser through the Vite proxy, the staff API admission steps and the conversations feature into one PostgreSQL transaction that also queues an agent job. The worker later claims the job, runs the graph inside a masked trace and writes an outbox intent. The browser learns the result by polling.

svg.text: database(user) opens one transaction with the RLS claim
membership, rate_limit, then operation lock and replay
intake writes conversation, message and queued agent job
commit makes all rows visible together
finish_job only if the fence still
